text.en:
Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Coins to be Issued on 22nd September 1998
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 22nd September 1998 by the Board of Commissioners of Currency, Singapore, are as shown in the Schedule.
